audit: Independent source-heading cue and heuristic-preview sense-packet integration review
approval_scope: add_context_relevance and its sense_packet integration only; not other concurrent packet-size/wire-choice changes, semantic accuracy, a paid experiment or deployment approval

tests.command: runtime/venv-syntax/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_commentary_relevance_packet.py tests/test_commentary_retrieval.py tests/test_edition_commentary.py tests/test_sense_ranker.py tests/test_ranked_sense_alternatives.py -q

checks: The consumer compares packet source ID/full Greek and target text/offsets with its supplied passage and occurrence. It compares the complete compact commentary view canonically before adding cues.

The source helper independently reloads approved commentary and verifies source identity and literal occurrence. The consumer now requires helper status available before any packet mutation; unavailable, malformed or unsupported source context raises CommentaryContextUnavailable.

Four frozen real packets regain byte-equivalent semantic JSON after removing only the new retrieval-cue field, three heuristic-preview annotations and two interpretation constraints. Candidate inventories, bindings, complete commentary and original source context remain unchanged.

Selected morphology is explicitly marked current_heuristic_preview, selection_is_source_adjudication=false and constrains_sense_candidates=false. No parse or meaning is generated or selected by this metadata.
The appended guidance distinguishes neighboring headings from the target, retains whole-poem commentary and every source alternative, and disclaims occurrence alignment and attestation.

Independent coordinated mutations of both source commentary and packet commentary were rejected for forged heading and forged prose. Coordinated passage-text and target-offset changes were also rejected.
Independent simulated cue-bound failure and missing local source rejected before mutation. All six independent rejection probes verified the complete packet remained unchanged.
Production packet regression confirms the genuine Alcaeus 350 neighboring heading cues and preservation of the original result object.
resolved_audit_finding: Initial code retained coordinated forged caller commentary when helper revalidation returned unavailable. The approved code requires an available revalidated result and raises before modifying the packet, with a new coordinated-forgery regression and independent heading/prose/source/offset replays.
limitations: Retrieval relevance remains a hypothesis. No heading match or source-layout group is certified as explaining the target word's sense.
All model commentary must continue to satisfy the existing edition loader's source identity, OCR eligibility, scope and licensing restrictions.

The reviewed exported transformation is used with supplied source commentary for commentary-bearing packets. Production sense_packet independently obtains that commentary through its existing accepted loader.
No paid model call, prompt-effect accuracy measurement, new experiment-manifest approval or deployment occurred during this review.
mutations: Only this requested audit receipt was written by reviewer. Runtime modules, source data and deployed services were not edited.
